capacity_answer: Measured on 29 Oct from the live server: 20 people working at once is fine (all requests succeed, average 3.8 s per page). At 50 and 100 at once the hosting account hits its limit and most requests fail (69% and 75%), so 100 simultaneous users is NOT supported yet. The cause is the shared-hosting account limits (CPU, processes), not the database or the code. Code fixes released today made each request about 20% lighter; the limits must be raised by the host (or the backend moved to a VPS) before the test is repeated.
